content.summary: The inspected source map preserves the hypotheses of the small-rank, isolation, B4, high-link and guarded prior results. The new exact-rho7 argument is correctly separated from the imported R16 theorem. Direct literal checks support the canonical models and Q8 leaf-sharing domain. No necessary source-map revision was identified; full finite-leaf and projection verification remains outside this round.

findings.statement: The size-15 exact-rho7 classification is a new written deduction using the imported I7 catalogue and its mixed-trace restrictions; it is not an immediate instance of the prior size-16 R16 theorem.
findings.disposition: The new companion map makes this distinction correctly. The source-located proof handles the additional size-15 H6/H7 and H2 cases rather than transferring the size-16 conclusion.

revisions.action: Compared the source-map claims with the pinned prior main.tex, including its small-rank, R16, maximality, crowding, cross-star and R61 statements.
revisions.result: The local source mapping is supported. External H27/Jin and the finite prior catalogue remain imported with the previously stated assurance limitations.

revisions.action: Inspected the added definitions and source map; read the exact-rho7 classification and Q8 gluing bridge; independently checked the literal gluing criterion.
revisions.result: The inspected arbitrary-support interfaces and permitted component identifications are supported. This does not certify every later model row or finite leaf.

checks.method: Read pinned repository/paper/main.tex, lines 188-350, and compared with manuscript Section 3 and the new definitions map.
checks.observation: The SF2 theorem allows precisely maximum degree and matching number at most two, yielding the six-edge cap and the stated five/six-edge root types. The intersecting SF3 proof derives its support restrictions rather than assuming them. Isolation treats P-type supports and the Q8 five-point core differently. B4 applies to an actual triple with at least eight disjoint members, which matches the exact-singleton interpretation inside a complete point-link.

checks.scope: R16 and complete-link decompositions at degrees 17-20
checks.method: Read pinned main.tex, lines 443-462 and 612-635, and checked the maximality argument against the manuscript's component conventions.
checks.observation: The R16 hypothesis is exactly |L|=16 and rho(L)<=7. Its nonextendibility also excludes extensions using new points: a new triple avoids the saturated hubs and uses at most one point per triad, leaving two disjoint old triples avoiding it. B4 and isolation then give the stated separated 17-20 alternatives. The new manuscript correctly reserves full support separation for these high-degree decompositions.

checks.scope: Guarded cross-star, crowding and R61 transfer
checks.method: Read pinned main.tex, the Crowding bound proof and R61 statement at lines 968-1060, and compared with prior-unlock and manuscript Section 3.
checks.observation: The source requires mu>=41 and Delta<=18. The cross-star argument additionally requires both centres outside both tail supports, actual lifted members, intersecting tails and cross-intersection. R61 requires a complete R16 link. These guards are retained in the manuscript and activated only after the degree-19 exclusion.

checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-rho7-classification.md in full and compared its imported catalogue and H2 shape reductions with pinned main.tex, lines 465-529 and 565-611.
checks.observation: The eight literal I7 types and their allowed mixed traces agree with the source. The size-15 proof separately eliminates H6 and H7 using degree/pair capacities, where the source's size-16 disjoint-count shortcut would no longer suffice. Its H2 split treats one or two uv-triples and derives hub or outer deletions. The stated theorem requires rho exactly seven and does not consume the unresolved rho<=6 case as an assumption.

checks.scope: Literal canonical models and Q8 leaf identifications
checks.method: Used an independent bounded Python 3 set calculation on the displayed P10, R16 and eight literal I7 templates; tested every three-member sunflower in 232 Q8/I7 leaf-identification placements.
checks.observation: P10 is SF3 with six degrees equal to five; R16 is SF3 with rho=7 and its single deletions have exactly the two stated degree multisets. In every tested Q8/I7 union, sunflower-freeness is equivalent to each shared leaf having an intersecting residual point-link. Allowed vertices are none in H0,H1,H3,H4,H5; {0} in H2,H6; and {5,6} in H7, exactly as in LOW15-A3-cover-independent-bridge.md, Exact ordinary criterion for a Q8 leaf gluing. This verifies the local gluing rule, not the full cover enumeration.
